summary: Trinity Capital Inc. filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, reporting entry into an underwriting agreement dated September 30, 2026, with Keefe, Bruyette & Woods and MUFG Securities Americas as representatives, for the issuance of $350 million aggregate principal amount of 7.500% Notes due 2032. The notes mature January 15, 2032, pay semi-annual interest on January 15 and July 15 beginning January 15, 2027, and are unsecured senior obligations. This routine debt offering, not a special situation, includes a ninth supplemental indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee.
